fix.summary: HEAD 397c132 is not finally converged. Two accepted class families remain open at executable production seams: sealed Navigator read truth loses partial-read state, and compatible ledger losers can continue stale local lifecycle execution instead of reconciling to canonical state. All other accepted Review-003/004/005 classes are explicitly closed below.

classes.name: NavigatorEvidenceReadTruth
classes.owner: Navigator evidence store to Navigator receipt validation seam
classes.boundary: Authoritative byte coverage, including partial coverage, must bind the Receipt read record.
classes.disposition: OPEN. The in-seat store is truthful, but the package E2E seam is lossy: sealedEvidenceReads filters to complete IDs and Runner reconstructs all retained IDs as fullyRead:true. Thus Review-003's required truthful partial-read case is not preserved through Recorder.

classes.name: RecorderFailureTruth
classes.owner: Recorder to Assisted Runner invocation settlement seam
classes.boundary: Arbitrary transport exceptions must retain causal identity and must not become fabricated sealed settlements.
classes.disposition: CLOSED. invokeNavigator and invokeRole exceptions now propagate from the production Runner without synthetic hashes or settlement publication; only typed Recorder failureJson is converted by the Recorder transport into infrastructure evidence.

classes.name: LedgerLoserReread
classes.owner: Assisted ledger publication and Assisted Runner lifecycle seam
classes.boundary: Publication losers must reread and reconcile canonical lifecycle truth rather than leak a race or repeat execution.
classes.disposition: OPEN. The wrapper rereads, but an exact winning event is merely returned to a caller that continues using stale rows. A loser delayed until the winner settles/completes can start another consultation rather than return canonical completed truth.

classes.name: IdentifierAndSnapshotClosure
classes.owner: Navigator contract validation and shared UUIDv7 primitive
classes.boundary: Deep latestAttempt validation and one shared UUIDv7 predicate.
classes.disposition: CLOSED. validateSettledAttempt closes and validates every nested identity/role/phase/target/class/reference field, and Navigator, Assisted config, Recorder config, and run locator use src/uuidv7.ts.

classes.name: PromotedArgvCredentialBoundary
classes.owner: Assisted selected command admission before ledger and Recorder promotion
classes.boundary: Authoritative credential scanning must precede durable argv publication or child launch.
classes.disposition: CLOSED. run calls validateSelectedPiArgvV1 before runIndex or ledger activity, and that validator invokes the Recorder scanner before returning promoted argv; recovery rescans stored argv.

classes.name: NavigatorEvidenceReadTruthResidual
classes.owner: Recorder sealed Navigator settlement and Navigator receipt admission seam
classes.boundary: Live and recovered sealed settlements must reconstruct the authoritative typed evidence-read record from native evidence-tool results.
classes.disposition: OPEN. src/assisted-recorder-transport.ts returns only fully covered string IDs, and src/assisted-runner.ts manufactures fullyRead:true records. The current residual test mocks invokeNavigator and does not traverse evidence tool -> native session -> Recorder sealing or readSealed recovery. Repair the existing settlement type, without a second tracker, and prove partial=false, complete paged=true, plus rejection of forged, omitted, duplicate, unknown, and unread entries in live and recovery paths.

classes.name: RecoveryEnvironmentIdentity
classes.owner: Assisted call declaration and crash recovery credential boundary
classes.boundary: Recovery preserves caller policy through an opaque binding without persisting raw values.
classes.disposition: CLOSED. call_started stores environmentReference plus a default-redacted recoveryConfig; recover resolves caller-owned material, checks its digest binding, rescans argv, and fails when unavailable or mismatched. Focused Navigator and role abandonment tests verify policy equivalence and secret absence.

classes.name: LedgerLoserRereadResidual
classes.owner: Assisted ledger publication and Assisted Runner lifecycle reconciliation seam
classes.boundary: A compatible loser must reconcile the pending transition and never launch a child after losing its reservation or recovery transition.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Exact-event conflict handling returns the winning row but does not return reconciled lifecycle state. run/recover continue from pre-conflict rows; once the winner's invocation has settled, unresolved no longer fences a second Navigator start. Existing concurrency coverage races different enter callIds only and has no deterministic identical-replay or concurrent-recovery barriers. Add production races that delay the loser until the winner advances/completes and prove canonical stored result/status, one recovery fact, one Navigator, at most one selected role, and fail-closed incompatible/corrupt truth.

classes.name: ResolvedSubjectIdentityOnResume
classes.owner: Assisted acquisition and resume immutable subject gate
classes.boundary: Resume must reacquire and compare resolved repository and parent IDs before publication or child launch.
classes.disposition: CLOSED. resume reacquires before normal lifecycle publication and compares resolvedSubject against the first acquisition; focused repo, parent, and combined drift cases reject before another role.

classes.name: Navigator Soul layering
classes.owner: Navigator Soul owner under the owner-direct revision channel
classes.boundary: Soul retains advisory professional judgment while runtime owns tool mechanics.
classes.disposition: CLOSED. Owner-direct commit 0ec5255 removed the mechanical tool inventory and retained least-cost safe-process judgment, failure honesty, caller autonomy, and nonbinding advice. Runtime tests continue to own the exact two-tool gate.

classes.name: Assisted run locator UUIDv7 predicate
classes.boundary: Public locator operations use the shared UUIDv7 predicate.
classes.disposition: CLOSED. runIndex delegates to isUuidV7; public readAssistedRunV1 coverage admits canonical syntax to normal lookup and rejects uppercase, wrong-version, and malformed IDs.

classes.name: Dense AssistedCall validator names
classes.boundary: Only local validator names change; contract and module shape remain unchanged.
classes.disposition: CLOSED. The cited subject/GitHub/acquisition/execution/path/provenance locals are domain-named in validateAssistedCallConfigV1 with no new abstraction or validation behavior.

classes.name: Tracker observation freshness digest
classes.owner: Navigator snapshot canonicalization consumed by Assisted Runner freshness gate
classes.boundary: Only capturedAt is normalized; parent and child observedAt remain decision-bearing.
classes.disposition: CLOSED. canonicalSnapshotDigestV1 normalizes capturedAt only. Contract tests bind parent and child observation times and reject old bindings; the lifecycle test proves observation-time-only prelaunch drift causes reconsultation before role launch.
